name: Echoing Amber Vault
description: A vaulted chamber where golden amber preserves not insects but sounds — each droplet a frozen melody, chime, or whisper, glowing warmer when approached.
prompt: Vaulted cathedral chamber, walls lined with massive golden amber formations preserving sounds as visible waveforms frozen in resin, each droplet containing a different melody — bird songs, laughter, heartbeats, chimes, whispers, amber glowing warmer amber when viewed, dramatic side lighting, subsurface scattering, photorealistic, 8k, cinematic
caption: Listen with your eyes. The loudest memories glow brightest. 🎵🟡
